name: Kalman filter / state-space models
summary: Recursively estimates a hidden state (trend, level, time-varying coefficient) from noisy observations.
inputs: Observed series plus a state-space specification (transition, observation, noise covariances).
outputs: Filtered and smoothed state estimates with uncertainty; forecasts; likelihood.

data_requirements.min_observations: Tens of points for simple local-level models

assumptions: Linear state transition and observation equations
Gaussian noise (optimal under these; otherwise best linear estimator)
math_summary: Recursive predict-update: x_t = F x_{t-1} + w_t, y_t = H x_t + v_t. The filter propagates the state mean and covariance and corrects with the Kalman gain K = P H'(H P H' + R)^-1.
when_to_use: Noisy or irregular series with a latent signal (trend, level, beta)
when_not_to_use: Strongly non-linear dynamics (use extended/unscented or particle filters)

compute.complexity: O(n * k^3) for state dimension k.

applicability.use_case: Time-varying beta or hedge ratio between two price series
Extracting a smooth trend from noisy monthly indicators with gaps
